title: Indian River Preserve Golf Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Formerly known as Walkabout Golf Club, Indian River Preserve Golf Club is nestled just off Interstate 95 in Mims, Florida near Titusville. This spectacular 18-hole golf course co-designed by renowned golf course architect Perry Dye and LPGA champion Jan Stephenson.
